categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Highlander Digital Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main segments: intelligent navigation for ships, marine observation and detection equipment, and underwater data centers (UDC). The company provides integrated smart maritime solutions including ship intelligent navigation systems, composite radar systems, engine automation, and ship-shore integrated communication systems. It also develops deep-sea engineering equipment and services, and commercial underwater data centers that leverage marine renewable energy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as solid-state radar with Doppler processing, integrated navigation systems certified by international classification societies, and atmospheric diving suits for deep-sea operations. Its underwater data centers employ high-pressure sealed containers cooled by seawater for energy-efficient operation, integrating intelligent power transmission and management systems with offshore wind power. The company also develops marine sensors, acoustic communication devices, and autonomous monitoring platforms including unmanned vessels and underwater gliders.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include oceanographic research institutions, telecommunications operators, offshore wind power operators, internet companies, and third-party IDC providers. The company serves maritime sectors such as deep-sea engineering, shipping (including ocean-going, coastal, inland, and defense vessels), marine disaster prevention, and digital economy infrastructure. Its markets span government projects, commercial shipping, marine scientific research, and emerging digital industries like AI computing and cloud services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant activities in Hainan Free Trade Port, Shanghai, Guangdong, Shandong, and other coastal regions. It has established R&D and service networks in Canada, Germany, and Russia, and subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Germany. Overseas markets include Europe and North America, supported by international certifications and partnerships.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing Highlander operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the marine technology and digital infrastructure supply chain. It designs, manufactures, and integrates marine equipment and systems, provides engineering services, and operates underwater data centers. The company also engages in technology development and system integration, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider rather than a raw material supplier or pure end-user.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in AI-enabled intelligent navigation, solid-state radar technology, and underwater data center integration with renewable energy. It focuses on autonomous navigation, visual enhancement, scenario perception, and green smart inland navigation. R&D priorities include developing fully domestic solid-state navigation radars to overcome supply chain constraints, advancing marine sensor technologies, and expanding underwater data center commercial applications. The company also invests in digital transformation platforms integrating ship and shore data services.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of marine observation equipment, intelligent ship systems, and underwater data center solutions. The company also earns income from technical services, system integration, equipment leasing, and maintenance contracts. Additionally, it receives government subsidies and investment income from financial assets. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales and some distribution channels, with contracts spanning domestic and international customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in China's marine technology and underwater data center sectors, recognized for pioneering solid-state radar certifications and integrated marine systems. It competes with domestic and international marine equipment manufacturers and data center operators. Its strategic partnerships with telecom operators, wind power companies, and internet firms strengthen its competitive edge. The company is regarded as a technology leader in intelligent navigation and marine observation solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 384 million RMB, a 49% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to project timing and strategic focus on high-margin orders. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about 8.2 million RMB, reversing prior losses. Total assets stood at around 2.44 billion RMB with a slight growth. The company increased R&D investment significantly, dedicating over 22% of revenue to innovation. Despite revenue decline, profitability and cash flow improved, reflecting operational adjustments and strategic repositioning.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Beijing Highlander emphasizes its over 20 years of marine technology expertise, proprietary core technologies, and comprehensive system integration capabilities. Its underwater data centers uniquely combine green energy from offshore wind with efficient seawater cooling, offering low-cost, environmentally friendly digital infrastructure. The company’s solid-state radar systems have achieved international certifications, enhancing maritime safety and navigation precision. Its integrated ship-shore platforms and autonomous marine monitoring solutions provide customers with enhanced operational efficiency, safety, and digital transformation support.
